notes.title: Changelog For The Upcoming Full Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/8a070b1d77060c1baeec954c886ea2ed75439927.png[/img][h1]Quick Word From The Developers[/h1]

Hello everyone! We want to, first of all, thank you all for your patience and bearing with us through this period. We know we have been rather quiet on the announcement front, but that is because we have both been hard at work improving the game and incorporating all the feedback we have received. We are in the final testing phase as we are ironing out and fixing some bugs with the game in preparation for our 1.0 release. While we do not have a firm date yet, we are aiming to release the game before the end of the year.

In the meantime, we wanted to post a list of the changes and updates we have made to the game to let you know what we have been up to over the past 6 months. We hope you are as excited to play the game as we are and, as always, if you have any suggestions or run into any problems, please let us know!

Yours truly,

Zzensan and VanguardMaster


[h1]Upcoming Changelog[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added  playable Orc faction to campaign mode: 3 orc subspecies, 14 units (including a monster unit)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/3bab58da8b90baa934a20d25903bcd1d1f3f4939.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/b91564bdfa1dc72cd9cff1a352ba6453b543a5d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/64731240878d2d99a1d93bd138372f6a2e4af4a2.png[/img]
[*] Added Orc faction to battle mode
[*] Added new battle terrain system for selecting battle maps so that battle maps reflect player surroundings based on campaign map location
[*] Added 6 new player commanders to choose from
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/3b365549d41bbe0c1168e18e98239ec0a5e6da3b.png[/img]
[*] Added 4 new units to the Kingdom of Arran roster, including a mortar artillery unit
[*] Added 3 new units to the Crusade roster, including new spell casters
[*] Added 30+ new attack, death, and hit animations to all units during battles
[/list]

[h2]Battles[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added ESC menu to battles, allowing the player to pause the battle and forfeit battle
[*] Added 2 new city assault battle maps
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/58133aa3bd172a086031f5b91fea805cd4414c95.png[/img]
[*] Added 3 new field battle maps
[*] Added new battle maps to battle mode
[*] Optimized AI pathing during battles
[*] Added battle AI logic to surround and envelop enemies
[*] Optimized unit LODs and textures during battles to improve performance
[*] Reworked unit collision boxes to better represent the size of each unit
[*] Reworked all unit models and added 15+ new weapons and shields
[*] Added status effects during battle such as on fire, poison, bleeding, and healing
[*] Added new VFX to magical spells and artillery such as new fireball, mortar, magic arrows, etc
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/039919d844786fd5e1a8be6fa83f5d158a674581.png[/img]
[*] Added new light and heavy attacks to all units
[*] Added special attacks and abilities to 12 units
[*] Ranged units will now switch to melee attacks when enemies get too close
[*] Rebalanced all unit attributes during battles such as health, damage, movement speed, attack speed, range, etc
[*] Increased maximum battle cap from 1000 troops to 1500 troops on the battlefield at one time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/04c8b85655cd4ebea240d58e109c3c3274c723ed.png[/img]

[/list]


[h2]Campaign[/h2]

[list]
[*] Changed gameplay focus from kingdom and city management to army management. Player faction cities will be AI controlled while the player focuses on recruiting troops to army and helping their faction conquer cities and expand its influence
[*] Added new player camp mechanic to the campaign map where the player can recruit troops and unlock commanders
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/1b4e35b6e82b1136d06f679a854877d45ba4f7d7.png[/img]
[*] Significantly improved campaign AI logic for improved targeting and recruitment of armies
[*] Added win/lose condition to campaign gameplay. If the player conquers all cities, they will win the campaign, whereas if the player faction loses all cities and and the player loses their army, they will lose the campaign
[*] Overhauled player economy to switch it from resource based to gold based. Various ways of getting gold have been added
[*] Added mechanic where player gains passive tax income from cities owned by their faction
[*] Killing bandit parties will now give gold to the player and resources to the closest allied city thus helping the player faction recruit armies faster
[*] Overhauled bandit parties size on campaign map and and balanced bandit units in battles
[*] Overhauled garrison parties and increased their size by up to 150%
[*] Increased campaign movement speed by 50%
[/list]


[h2]UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Overhauled battle UI
[*] Greatly improved campaign map UI: added city names, army labels showing faction and size of army, added colours to city and army labels to indicate allegiance (blue = player, green=ally, red=enemy)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767787/e4ba890e01439c60fc7446d244c878ce4bfd1ca7.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash when loading save
[*] Fixed bug where commander would not load into the battle map
[*] Fixed bug where commander was not saved after battles and needed to be recruited again
[*] Fixed bug where some units were unable to hit enemies in front of them
[*] Fixed villager caravans getting attacked by enemy parties
[*] Fixed crossbowmen using the wrong ammunition for their crossbows
[*] Fixed crash when attempting to load too many units in the battle at once
[*] Fixed visual bug in Settings menu when selecting resolution
[*] Fixed bug where troops were disappearing from player army when AI fought battles
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi everyone, here is our second major addition to the game![/h1]

We want to start off with a big thank you for everyone's patience as we have had to cut back our team which has resulted in some delays with development. However, we are still working on the roadmap we published earlier this year, and while we expect some minor delays, we are continuing to make progress.



We have finally completed the multiplayer mode, which includes a 1v1 arena style map. We will be releasing more maps as development progresses, but we first want to hear your feedback on the multiplayer gameplay. As always, please let us know of any bugs or issues you come across, and let us know if you have any suggestions for improvements you would like to see.


[b]The next big update to look forward to will be a brand new race: The Orcs!!![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Added[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "move to" command during battles based on player feedback, this will allow you to reform and move unit group to a new location.
[*] Melee Units will now not stand idle when attacked and not given a command but charge when the enemy comes close.
[*] 
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

The following changes were made due to feedback from you guys!

[list]
[*] Removed tech tree and made all buildings and villages buildable from start of the game, to improve the flow of the gameplay. Certain units still need to be unlocked.
[*] Lowered starting gold back to 100
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Removed navmesh on top of trees
[*] Fixed bug where on certain maps, troops could not move
[*] Solved bug with day counter resetting after every battle
[*] Improve Campaign Map performance
[*] Fixed problem with ranged units retreating
[*] Enemy units kept training after Town was taken over.
[*] Enemy buildings now get destroyed when taking over towns
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]Based on your feedback we have made some adjustments to gameplay and also fixed some bugs[/b]

[h1]Gameplay Changes:[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] You will now receive a notification whenever a technology is done researching.

[*] Added Captains, Captains are a unit between commanders and units that the player can controll, instead of spawning with a spectator camera when a battle starts and you have no commander, now you spawn as a captain so you can start of playing instead of watching!

[*] Added Captains to be recruited as commanders, weaker but free of gold cost.

[/list]

[h2]Adjusted[/h2]

[list]
[*] Made changes to AI teams to present a better lategame opponent.

[*] You can now close all Menus by pressing escape.
[/list]


[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed some texts that were out of bounds.

[*] Removed Battle texts that were leftovers of an old system.

[*] Village Highlights when building are fixed and the village should now turn entirely red or green based on if you can build there or not.

[*] All Units will now Chase the player if they have no ther valid Targets left instead of attacking dead units.

[/list]

[b]If you have any suggestions or bugs please make sure to report them in our discord or on our forums![/b]
